title: Events in Portugal, by place
what: Public events on now or in the next 60 days in Lisbon and the Algarve places, as schema.org Event records, each with its source URL and the time read.
publisher: Câmara Municipal de Lisboa (Agenda Cultural de Lisboa, agendalx.pt) and Câmara Municipal de Lagos (cm-lagos.pt)

schedule.how: the Pages workflow (.github/workflows/pages.yml) at 17 minutes past 00, 06, 12 and 18 UTC (the agendas change daily); every other hourly run keeps the last read, copied from the live site

terms.summary: Strictest of the sources: no reuse licence or terms page was found for either host. Both robots.txt files allow the paths read; agendalx.pt sets Content-Signal search=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference. So: reference use only, name the source, link to the event, no AI training. Not reviewed by a person: whether this is enough to republish is for Dinis.
terms.republish: unclear: no licence found; reference use with attribution and a link to each event's page
terms.open_question: No reuse terms were found on agendalx.pt, lisboa.pt (403) or cm-lagos.pt. Dinis to decide whether to republish on this basis, or to ask Câmara Municipal de Lisboa and Câmara Municipal de Lagos.

code: the collector reads robots.txt, then the agenda route or page, and writes latest.json and reads.json
GitHub Actions runs it every hour and deploys the site
agents: data.b.collector@PrompTugal.dinis (Sonnet) researched the sources and wrote the collector and this card on 18 November 2026, for data.b@PrompTugal.dinis
people: Dinis Cruz decided the events collection on 18 November 2026; no person has checked the values yet (not reviewed)

cost.runner: GitHub Actions on a public repository: no charge; about 12 requests and 30 seconds a run (measured locally, 18 November 2026)
cost.note: Code only: no model is called when the data is collected.
